```yaml
name: Godot Addon CI

on:
  push:
    branches: [ "main" ]
  pull_request:
    branches: [ "main" ]

jobs:
  build:
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        include:
          - name: "Linux"
            runner: "ubuntu-latest"
            platform: "linux"
            build_type: "Release"
          - name: "macOS"
            runner: "macos-latest"
            platform: "macos"
            build_type: "Release"
          - name: "Windows"
            runner: "windows-latest"
            platform: "windows"
            build_type: "Release"

    runs-on: ${{ matrix.runner }}

    steps:
    - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      with:
        submodules: recursive

    - name: Setup Python
      uses: actions/setup-python@v5
      with:
        python-version: '3.12'

    - name: Install dependencies
      run: |
        pip install numpy scipy

    - name: Setup Godot
      run: |
        ./setup_godot.sh

    - name: Create build directory
      run: |
        mkdir -p build

    - name: Configure CMake (Windows)
      if: matrix.platform == 'windows'
      run: |
        cmake -B build -DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=${{ matrix.build_type }} -G "Visual Studio 16 2019" -A x64

    - name: Configure CMake (Linux/macOS)
      if: matrix.platform != 'windows'
      run: |
        cmake -B build -DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=${{ matrix.build_type }}

    - name: Build (Windows)
      if: matrix.platform == 'windows'
      run: |
        cmake --build build --config ${{ matrix.build_type }} --parallel 4

    - name: Build (Linux/macOS)
      if: matrix.platform != 'windows'
      run: |
        cmake --build build --parallel 4

    - name: Copy Godot source files
      run: |
        cp -r src/* godot/

    - name: Remove amy_midi.c from Godot build
      run: |
        rm -f godot/amy_midi.c

    - name: Add MIDI stubs to amy_platform_stubs.c
      run: |
        echo '#ifdef _WIN32
#include <windows.h>
void amy_midi_init() {}
void amy_midi_send(unsigned char status, unsigned char data1, unsigned char data2) {}
void amy_midi_close() {}
#else
// Existing stubs for other platforms
#endif' >> godot/amy_platform_stubs.c

    - name: Build Godot addon
      run: |
        cd godot
        make

    - name: Package addon
      run: |
        mkdir -p addon
        cp -r godot/* addon/
        zip -r amy-addon-${{ matrix.platform }}.zip addon

    - name: Upload artifact
      uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
      with:
        name: amy-addon-${{ matrix.platform }}
        path: amy-addon-${{ matrix.platform }}.zip
```
